body.prompt: Extreme close-up: inside a fire pit a dark oak chest engulfed in flames, its lid cracked and split open by the heat, tightly rolled papyrus scrolls and folded letters inside blackening and curling, the writing is only blurred dark smudges with nothing readable, bright embers and sparks rising, very shallow depth of field. Photorealistic film still from a prestige epic historical drama, shot on ARRI Alexa with anamorphic lenses, natural skin pores and wrinkles, real wool, leather and bronze textures, volumetric firelight and thin smoke haze, deep teal-black shadows against warm orange firelight, shallow depth of field, subtle 35mm film grain, realistic human hands with five fingers. Not a painting, not an illustration. Horizontal 16:9 widescreen frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame.
